context: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS A dose of CAYSTON consists of a single-use vial of sterile, lyophilized aztreonam (75 mg) reconstituted with a 1 mL ampule of sterile diluent (0.17% sodium chloride). Reconstituted CAYSTON is administered by inhalation.
